title: Kilagen Framework Clause Vocabulary
description: Validates program/frameworks/<id>.yml — the authoritative, edition-pinned clause-reference list for one framework. Reference-not-copy: clause refs only (the text lives at the framework's url in config.yml). The file stem is the framework id and must match a config.yml frameworks[].id.

clauses.description: Flat list of clause-reference strings, unique within the file. Quote every value so numeric-looking refs (e.g. "13.60") are not collapsed to floats by the YAML parser.
